# Quran Akademie


> Quran Akademie offers live 1-on-1 online Quran classes for children and adults in Germany, in English and German. Certified tutors (male and female teachers available), lessons scheduled in Germany time (CET/CEST, after-school and evening slots), and a free trial class with no payment details required. Courses: Noorani Qaida, Quran Reading with Tajweed, Hifz-ul-Quran, Tafseer & Understanding, and Islamic Studies for Kids. Plans: Basic $35/month (4 classes/week, 25 min), Standard $59/month (5/week, 30 min), Hifz Intensive $99/month (5/week, 45 min).

## Courses

- [Noorani Qaida](https://onlinekoran.de/courses/noorani-qaida): First steps in reading Arabic — letters, sounds and joining, for complete beginners (ages 4+).
- [Quran Reading with Tajweed](https://onlinekoran.de/courses/tajweed): Fluent, beautiful recitation with correct pronunciation and the rules of Tajweed.
- [Hifz-ul-Quran](https://onlinekoran.de/courses/hifz): Structured memorisation with revision cycles, guided by an experienced Hafiz or Hafiza.
- [Tafseer & Understanding](https://onlinekoran.de/courses/tafseer): Meanings, context and lessons from the Quran, in plain language (teens & adults).
- [Islamic Studies for Kids](https://onlinekoran.de/courses/kids-islamic-studies): Salah, duas, seerah stories and good manners for children ages 5–12.
